diff --git a/newsletter.py b/newsletter.py
index 1b6fead..d529d49 100644
--- a/newsletter.py
+++ b/newsletter.py
@@ -2,6 +2,8 @@
 import csv
 from datetime import date, timedelta
 
+INACTIVE_AFTER_DAYS = 180
+
 
 def load_members(path="members.csv"):
     """Columns: email, name, status (paid or lapsed), last_opened (YYYY-MM-DD, blank if never)."""
@@ -15,6 +17,15 @@ def load_members(path="members.csv"):
 
 
 def mailing_list(members, today=None):
-    """Email addresses to send this month's newsletter to."""
+    """Email addresses to send this month's newsletter to.
+
+    Members who have never opened an email, or whose last open was more than
+    INACTIVE_AFTER_DAYS days ago, are left out. Membership status is ignored.
+    """
     today = today or date.today()
-    return [m["email"] for m in members]
+    cutoff = today - timedelta(days=INACTIVE_AFTER_DAYS)
+    return [
+        m["email"]
+        for m in members
+        if m["last_opened"] is not None and m["last_opened"] >= cutoff
+    ]
diff --git a/tests/test_newsletter.py b/tests/test_newsletter.py
index ffe0a84..abe4f79 100644
--- a/tests/test_newsletter.py
+++ b/tests/test_newsletter.py
@@ -1,7 +1,9 @@
-from datetime import date
+from datetime import date, timedelta
 
 from newsletter import load_members, mailing_list
 
+TODAY = date(2026, 6, 30)
+
 
 def test_load_members(tmp_path):
     p = tmp_path / "m.csv"
@@ -16,4 +18,34 @@ def test_engaged_paid_members_get_it():
         {"email": "a@x.org", "status": "paid", "last_opened": date(2026, 6, 1)},
         {"email": "b@x.org", "status": "paid", "last_opened": date(2026, 6, 20)},
     ]
-    assert mailing_list(members, today=date(2026, 6, 30)) == ["a@x.org", "b@x.org"]
+    assert mailing_list(members, today=TODAY) == ["a@x.org", "b@x.org"]
+
+
+def test_never_opened_is_excluded():
+    members = [
+        {"email": "a@x.org", "status": "paid", "last_opened": None},
+        {"email": "b@x.org", "status": "paid", "last_opened": date(2026, 6, 1)},
+    ]
+    assert mailing_list(members, today=TODAY) == ["b@x.org"]
+
+
+def test_lapsed_but_active_stays_on_list():
+    members = [
+        {"email": "a@x.org", "status": "lapsed", "last_opened": date(2026, 6, 1)},
+    ]
+    assert mailing_list(members, today=TODAY) == ["a@x.org"]
+
+
+def test_paid_but_inactive_is_excluded():
+    members = [
+        {"email": "a@x.org", "status": "paid", "last_opened": date(2025, 1, 1)},
+    ]
+    assert mailing_list(members, today=TODAY) == []
+
+
+def test_180_day_boundary():
+    members = [
+        {"email": "in@x.org", "status": "paid", "last_opened": TODAY - timedelta(days=180)},
+        {"email": "out@x.org", "status": "paid", "last_opened": TODAY - timedelta(days=181)},
+    ]
+    assert mailing_list(members, today=TODAY) == ["in@x.org"]
